mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees near Fireman's Park, with a full moon visible overhead.

September is National Senior Center Month, celebrating the great programs offered at the Verona Senior Center. You can sign up for free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail or enjoy daily meal options through their nutrition program.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today, and you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing tonight. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road after a request from the Department of Corrections regarding a probation violation.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and remains open until 10:00 PM.
